correction: A workflow guard must read every file that GitHub runs as a workflow, both .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml; a guard that globs only *.yml passes an unpinned or write-scoped .yaml workflow
A negative test that breaks a real workflow must read the pin it changes from the file, not name a fixed SHA: Dependabot bumps the pin, and a fixed SHA fails make ci on every bump PR
evidence: frostyard/homebrew-tap#33, Test run 42285766139: 3 B5 negative tests failed on the bump of jdx/mise-action from 5.2.2 to 5.2.6
